explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.

hero.html: 2 configurations over 1 sweep (shape), each at 2 load levels, every run on exactly 2 GPUs.
1x TP2, from the shape sweep, reached 1045.23 tok/s/GPU (2090.5 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 32 while holding the scenario's SLOs.
1x TP2 at concurrency 32. 2 of 4 runs held the SLOs.
